title: Get started with SticsREval
text: workflow three stages, handled plain functions taking explicit arguments: Prepare data: build STICS text workspace SMS repository gen_workspace_from_sms(), run STICS version run_simulations(). produces RDS files simulations observations. Evaluate: compare candidate version observations reference version evaluate(), check water nitrogen balances balance_closure_test(). Report: render exported results HTML dashboard render_report(). evaluate() balance_closure_test() never run STICS : read RDS files produced run_simulations(). Simulations can thus computed evaluated many times.

title: Get started with SticsREval
text: gen_workspace_from_sms() converts SMS repository (XML input files) STICS text workspace, one folder per USM: restrict workspace USMs, pass names usms. can read text files listing one USM per line read_usms_files():
code: gen_workspace_from_sms(   sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",   stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",   output_dir = "workspace/" ) usms <- read_usms_files(c("usms_wheat.txt", "usms_maize.txt"))  gen_workspace_from_sms(   sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",   stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",   output_dir = "workspace/",   usms       = usms )

title: Get started with SticsREval
text: Run reference version . run_simulations() writes simulations.rds observations.rds output_dir: default, simulated variables observed ones. balance closure test needs additional, non-observed variables: use get_var_from_obs() combine sets single run candidate version.
code: run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_reference",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "reference/" ) balance_vars <- c(   "init_H2O_balance", "final_H2O_balance",   "init_plant_N_balance", "final_plant_N_balance",   "init_soil_mineral_N_balance", "final_soil_mineral_N_balance",   "init_soil_organic_N_balance", "final_soil_organic_N_balance",   "init_soil_organic_C_balance", "final_soil_organic_C_balance" )  obs <- SticsRFiles::get_obs("workspace/") vars <- c(get_var_from_obs(obs), balance_vars)  run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_candidate",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   vars           = vars )

title: Get started with SticsREval
text: evaluate() runs three evaluations candidate version: global: statistics species USMs combined; per species: variables whose rRMSE deteriorates percentage % compared reference flagged; per USM: USMs one variables locally degraded compared reference flagged. Variables fewer 10 observations tested. Results (CSV files interactive scatter plots) written output_dir, summary printed console. Without ref_sim_rds, candidate version evaluated observations . Set stop_on_failure = TRUE make evaluate() throw error evaluation fails, e.g. CI pipeline.
code: evaluate(   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   sim_rds        = "outputs/simulations.rds",   obs_rds        = "outputs/observations.rds",   ref_sim_rds    = "reference/simulations.rds",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   percentage     = 5 )

Like evaluate(), always reads pre-computed simulation data sim_rds — never runs simulations : Upstream, two standalone functions prepare data workflows consume, starting raw SMS repository: evaluate() never runs STICS simulations — always reads pre-computed sim_rds / obs_rds (ref_sim_rds). run_simulations() files produced, version evaluation reference version — see Data Preparation .

code: library(SticsREval)  balance_vars <- c(   "init_H2O_balance", "final_H2O_balance",   "init_plant_N_balance", "final_plant_N_balance",   "init_soil_mineral_N_balance", "final_soil_mineral_N_balance",   "init_soil_organic_N_balance", "final_soil_organic_N_balance",   "init_soil_organic_C_balance", "final_soil_organic_C_balance" )  # 1. Build a Stics text workspace from the raw SMS repository gen_workspace_from_sms(   sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",   stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",   output_dir = "workspace/" )  # 2. Pre-compute the reference version's simulations and observations once run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_reference",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "reference/" )  # 3. Run the candidate version's simulations, combining the observed #    variables with the balance closure ones into a single call obs  <- SticsRFiles::get_obs("workspace/") vars <- c(get_var_from_obs(obs), balance_vars)  run_simulations(   stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_candidate",   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   vars           = vars )  # 4. Evaluate the candidate version against the reference evaluate(   usms_workspace = "workspace/",   output_dir     = "outputs/",   sim_rds        = "outputs/simulations.rds",   obs_rds        = "outputs/observations.rds",   ref_sim_rds    = "reference/simulations.rds",   percentage     = 5 )  # 5. Check water and nitrogen balance closure balance_closure_test(   sim_rds    = "outputs/simulations.rds",   output_dir = "outputs/" )  # 6.
